caps: HIT 8% vs raid bosses for special attacks (300 weapon skill, no hit suppression in Forever); about 5% vs level-equal. Count Precision (now 3% max). After 8%, HIT only helps white hits (dual-wield white cap 27%), worth about 4 per 1%.

EXPERTISE about 6.5% from behind vs raid bosses: removes dodge, and parry doesn't happen from behind. About 14% if attacking from the front (dodge + parry). Past the from-behind cap it is worth about 0 for a rogue.
ASSASSINATION.notes: Rogue AGI = 1 AP; 29 AGI = 1% crit; 14.5 AGI = 1% dodge. STR = 1 AP only. Forever: poisons scale with AP and can crit, and Malice also adds poison crit, so AP and CRIT are a bit higher than for Combat. Mutilate needs daggers, so main-hand dagger damage matters. Lethality is reduced to 20%. Haste means more white hits and more poison procs; it is rare on gear with no breakpoints. Hit and crit are unified (melee = spell), so SHIT=HIT and SCRIT=CRIT; this makes poisons use the same hit/crit. wow.gg (2026-11-04) order: expertise > hit > agi > weapon dmg > crit. Icy Veins: hit is top until the cap. Warcraft Tavern: AGI is the core stat; final priority waits for level-60 data. Percent stats are ranked by per-point weight, so they come before AGI. EXPERTISE (per 1%) lowers the chance to be dodged or parried. wow.gg (2026-11-04) ranks it 1st. From behind, 1% expertise prevents about as many failed attacks as 1% hit, so it is weighted just above HIT. The 6.5%/14% caps come from the coordinator's addendum and match the classic boss dodge figure; I did not confirm them in a rogue source. RDPS = 0.5: the thrown/bow/gun slot is mostly a stat slot (pulling, Deadly Throw-style use only).
